content.text: Minor titles can be given out for prestige or opinion modifiers. They are defined in the files contained in the /common/minor_titles/ folder.
Note that minor titles are always scoped to the liege's main title, so it's not possible to give a title to a character that resides in a different court.

You can make a basic minor title in a really easy way. Add a .txt file to your mod's /common/minor_titles/ folder. As long as it does not have the same name as the files in the base game's /common/minor_titles/ folder it will add to the list of minor titles.
The example above will add a minor title that can be granted to any adult who is not incapable. It can only be granted in the kingdoms of lalaland and timbuktu, and they must be feudal.

rows: Displays an alert when the title is vacant.
The minor title will be displayed as the holder's main title, overriding other titles such as Count, Duke, etc.
Appends the name of the country after the title (Queen [of Sweden])
Whether the holder has a seat on the council. See Councillor modding .

Adds the specified amount of dignity to the title holder. See Title modding for a more complete description of dignity. In the context of minor titles, this presumably affects which minor title an unlanded character will use as their primary minor title. (Eg: A Designated Regent who is also the current Regent will appear as "Regent of X" in the character finder etc, because the Regent title has higher dignity than Designated Regent.) Note: This interpretation is not thoroughly tested & verified.
The optional main attribute that will improve the efficiency of the holder. When opening the UI the candidates will be sorted using this attribute by default.
Maximum number of holders for this title.
Opinion from the holder of title to his liege. 5 would be a +5 opinion.
The amount the holder will earn by holding this minor title in one month.
The amount of prestige accrued each month by the holder of this minor title.
Whether this title can be cumulated with another honorary title or not.
Determines which characters are eligible to hold this minor title. ROOT is the character being checked. FROM is the liege granting the title.
Determines who is allowed to grant this title. This might be restricted by religion, culture, traits, or simply limited to one kingdom or duchy.
Fires when the title is granted
Fires when a title is lost if allowed_to_hold evaluates to false
Fires when a character dies while holding this title
Fires a message to the its owner when set
Special title that determines the heir of a Patrician
Holder of the title counts as born-in-the-purple for Byzantine Empire succession.
Modifiers applied to the holder of the title.

You want the minor title to be named and described properly in the game, so we need to add some localisation. So create a new file in the /localisation/ folder of your mod. It must be a CSV file, so the name could be something like 00_Minor_titles.csv .
Note that the code for the description is simply the code for the minor title with _desc at the end.
